integrity: Complete derivation and executable finite checks supplied; no independent audit or historical-priority certification is asserted. The scientific claim is exact for all irrational slopes and all positive lengths/iterations.
limitations: Applies to factor languages of irrational binary Sturmian words with 0<alpha<1, positive length and iteration count, and the leftmost-one binary tortoise. Does not cover rational slopes, nonbinary words, other sorting maps, or occurrence counts. Finite checks are corroborative rather than infinite certificates. Historical-priority assessment is not exhaustive; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact \(k\)-tortoise complexity of every binary Sturmian language
